claims.statement: testplan/flows contains role-based regression flows with roles (CUS, DISPATCHER, DRIVER, OPS, ACCOUNTANT, ADMIN, CUSTOMER) and no hardcoded usernames; per-environment accounts resolve via testaccounts.txt with shared staging password Abc123.

GPS/telemetry and the AI-assistant feature were removed entirely on 2026-09-06, and the PENDING_EXPENSE_APPROVAL status and maker-checker flow were retired 2026-09-05; none of these may be documented as current.

SilverSea is a TingTing-platform deployment customized for the SilverSea container-trucking customer; local dev ports follow the two-checkout plan: backend 3002, frontend 7175 (strictPort), Postgres 5441, Redis 6391, Adminer 8083, with ss-prod-* dev containers (volume key ss-prod-pgdata) while the sibling silversea-main checkout keeps ss-main-* on 5442/6392/8084. The in-app demo mode is permanently disabled; make demo is the staging deploy to vantai.tingting.vip and make deploy is the user-gated production deploy.
The O2C state machine is NEW → DISPATCHED → IN_TRANSIT → COMPLETED with CANCELED as exception exit; docs/prd/QuyTrinhO2C.md is the canonical spec and diagram-based content is authoritative.

The merged dispatch surface pairs a master-plan grid (per-shipment, one schedule block per container appointment) with a detailed-plan grid (per-fulfillment) sharing the dispatch planning client and backend route family, and the dispatcher-selected per-container classification flows through the atomic plan save while the CUS-owned lot-level combined flag is stripped at the route.

The CUS settlement screen Chi phí – Quyết toán consolidates a customer's locked lots for debit-note export: top-bar customer filter (required), delivery-date range and lock-status filters, Lớp 1 lot rollups (freight, chi hộ, phải thu, phải trả, lợi nhuận, lock state), Lớp 2 container-keyed freight/chi-hộ tables with editable Phát sinh, and Xuất Debit Note issuing one consolidated note per customer per period, rejecting overlapping selections with a 409 naming the overlapping lot codes.

Kế toán chốt debit board (/accounting/chot-debit, accountant/admin; 2026-09-22, settled per-đợt since 2026-09-24): the per-lot KẾ HOẠCH ĐIỀU ĐỘNG TỔNG HỢP view with the fixed thu/trả column ladder, excel-style filters on customer and nhà xe, a confirmation-column rate-adjustment flow where a pending request blocks that lot's debit export, the Chọn Debit settlement popup (Lần/Tháng/THU-TRA/VAT per đợt, debit_settlement_rounds), and the TỔNG HỢP CÔNG NỢ KHÁCH HÀNG read-back table.

Two-source fund ledger (2026-09-22): sổ quỹ splits into TK công ty (ACB, COMPANY) and Tiền mặt (TM) streams; the operator's Lồng ghép ruling merged the legacy single-ledger history into the ACB stream (old entries visible immediately, running balances continuous) while cash starts at activation.

OPS read-only Sổ quỹ (2026-09-24, card _13): a scoped read-only fund-book section on /ops/wallet shows the OPS caller's own cash events (tạm ứng/hoàn ứng) with closing == wallet balance; full treasury remains ACCOUNTANT/ADMIN (ADR 2026-09-24-ops-fund-book-scoped-read).

Deposit-tracker overdue-CV alert (2026-09-24, card _14): red overdue line ('kiểm tra check cược số lượng: N lô hàng') + persistent money line + once-per-load toast, per-session dismissal, hidden at zero overdue; live-computed with the VN-calendar predicate (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh), no cron.

Quotation page split + import parity + inherit (2026-09-24): the config page splits route block + fee catalog section; import preview ≡ commit via the shared row validator (empty-giá → row-level error, commit refused); import-commit is idempotent (replay returns the stored response) and the new frame inherits the prior frame's fee catalog (ruling ii).
